title: Private time at sea, for the people you look after.
subtitle: Eagle Ray Expeditions runs private sailing expeditions out of La Paz, Baja California Sur, for groups of up to 8. You know your clients. We build the trip around them: boat, crew, route and food.
imageAlt: Crew and guests together at sea in Baja California Sur

whoCards.title: Travel advisors and agencies
whoCards.text: Your client trusts you with the plan. We give you a trip you can put your name next to: a private boat, a crew you can introduce by name, and a proposal ready to send.
whoCards.imageAlt: A slow moment on board: lunch, shade and a swim off the stern

whoCards.title: Hotel concierges
whoCards.text: A guest asks what's worth doing beyond the hotel. A few nights on the Sea of Cortez, with a captain, an Expedition Leader and a chef aboard, is a real answer.
whoCards.imageAlt: Food prepared by the chef on board

whoCards.title: Expedition Leaders
whoCards.text: You have a skill, a story and people who follow you. We put a boat and a crew around it, and you lead your own edition.

aboardPoints: A private boat. Only the group they chose, no strangers.
A crew picked for seamanship and hospitality: captain, Expedition Leader and chef.
3, 5 or 7 nights around Espíritu Santo, with no unbreakable agenda.
Starlink aboard, for the one call that can't wait.

formats.name: Recalibration Expedition
formats.text: Slow days, good food, quiet anchorages.

formats.name: Active Expedition
formats.text: More hours in the water, with snorkel, free diving and scuba.

formats.name: Ad-hoc Expedition
formats.text: Built from scratch around the group.

formats.name: Special editions
formats.text: Trips led by guest Expedition Leaders, a few times a year.

steps: Tell us about your client: group size, dates, and what they want from the days.
We send you a proposal with boat options, crew and price.
Your client confirms. Our crew takes it from the first message to the last anchorage.
benefits: A commission on every booking you bring. We walk you through the details.
A crew you can introduce by name, with real profiles and photos.
Proposals your clients can open and read on their phone.

limitedOffer.text: Until December 31, 2026: a discovery wine pack from Climats, our sommelier partner in Baja, to offer your clients.
